title: Engineering model interpretation and identity checks
description: Interpret supplied state-scoped model content under its declared profile and assess identity presence and uniqueness over an explicitly supplied candidate scope. These operations do not retain content or authorize changes.

operations.name: interpret_model_content
operations.purpose: Interpret content using the profile declared for its selected model state.
inputs: Selected model/state identity and raw content with its acquisition scope and completeness.
The state's declared profile identity and available authoritative profile definitions.
outputs: Interpreted content and declared profile with state/scope/completeness, or explicit missing, unsupported, incompatible, incomplete, or failed interpretation.

Identifiable governing interpretation context: applicable entity, field, relationship, cardinality, identity, naming, lifecycle, and validity definitions, directly available or through resolvable references bound to the selected state and profile.
behavior: Use the supplied declaration and applicable profile definitions without silently applying the newest profile.
Interpret identities, record kinds, and authoritative references only within the understood supplied scope.
Preserve incomplete acquisition limits in the result; successful interpretation of a portion does not establish full-state completeness.
Make this operation independent of IF-001 interpreted retrieval; raw content and its declaration are supplied by the caller.

Expose the governing definitions alongside interpretation results. A profile label without accessible rules does not establish an inspectable interpretation context; report unavailable context explicitly.

failure_behavior.condition: The declaration is absent, definitions unavailable, or a rule/type unsupported.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the interpretation gap without changing profiles or migrating the source.

failure_behavior.condition: The content/profile association is inconsistent or interpretation fails.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return the affected subject/state/scope and do not claim a complete valid interpretation.

operations.name: check_candidate_identities
operations.purpose: Determine identity presence and uniqueness in a supplied candidate model scope.
inputs: Candidate model state and its base-state identity.

Interpreted entity definitions forming the proposed resulting view (including the replacement of the same existing subject where applicable), declared profile, required scope, and explicit completeness of that supplied view.
outputs: Missing-identity and duplicate-identity findings with affected definitions, checked state/scope, and complete or incomplete identity-check outcome.
behavior: Require an explicit nonblank identity on every inspected entity.
Compare identities across distinct entities regardless of names, kinds, and locations; equal display names with different identities are permitted.
Report model-wide uniqueness only after the complete required candidate scope is inspected.
Return findings bound to the actual supplied candidate/state; the retaining caller must establish that the same candidate remains applicable at the point of retention.
An update replaces the original occurrence of the same subject in the candidate view; distinct entities must not be omitted or treated as that replacement to conceal duplicate identities.

failure_behavior.condition: A required part of the candidate view is missing or uninterpretable.
failure_behavior.outcome: Report incomplete checking and known findings without a model-wide validity conclusion.

failure_behavior.condition: Identity is absent or shared by distinct entities.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the conflicting records and reject identity validity for that candidate.

consistency_rules: The operation result identifies the supplied subject, profile, state, and inspected scope. It cannot be reused as a conclusion about a different candidate or revision.
Interpretation and identity-check findings are structural results, distinct from requirement satisfaction, semantic adequacy, and applicable authority.
No call obtains its own inputs by recursively requesting interpreted retrieval from IF-001; consumers provide the raw or interpreted candidate views specified by the operation.
compatibility_rules: Support is explicit for the profile declared by the subject state. Unsupported constructs receive a diagnostic rather than a fallback interpretation.
Changes to interpretation or identity-result meaning require reassessing both storage and authoring consumers and preserving historical-state meaning.
The contract chooses no parser, schema implementation, wire format, or migration mechanism.

sources.basis: Derive the conformance boundary from SR-002/FUNC-002 and shared SR-012/FUNC-012; preserve SR-014 separation of structural findings and judgments. Supplied scope avoids circular interpretation dependencies.
